Maria: pushed a small safety check and unit test to the runtime PR, addressed previous comments. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Ryan: will take a look now — quick Q: did you gate this behind a feature flag for canary?
Maria: yep added env var RUNTIME_SAFE_CHECK=false by default, can enable for dedicated canary with RUNTIME_SAFE_CHECK=true. noted in the PR description.
Jess: quick nit: log line should be debug not info (noisy in prod). otherwise looks good. :+1:
Maria: good catch — changed log to debug and pushed a new commit (fixed-nit).
ci-bot: CI checks started for commit 8f3d2b1 — running unit tests and linters.
ci-bot: All checks passed ✅
Tim: I can schedule a canary run this afternoon. prefer 15:00 PT. Maria does that work for you?
Maria: 15:00 PT works. I'll merge after you confirm the canary is queued.
Ryan: LGTM from me, thanks for handling the flag.
Jess: LGTM after the log change, thanks.
Tim: queued canary for 15:00 PT, will report back in #eng-sre when it's started.
Maria: thanks all — merging now and will follow up if the canary shows anything unexpected.
